03 / Contract beekeeping

A clear path from hive to harvest

Keep the bees.
We’ll help you grow.

When you buy hives from Oasis Necta, you join our contract beekeeping programme. You keep the bees. We make sure you are trained, supported and paid.

Join the programme ↗Read the contract ↗
01

Buy your hives

Choose Langstroth or Kenya top bar hives and the equipment you need.

02

Learn how to keep your bees and harvest properly.

03

Stay supported

Technical support continues while you produce.

04

We buy your honey and bee products at set prices.
